corpus.text: Backup archives are encrypted with AES-256 before leaving the workstation. Encryption keys are stored separately.
If an employee loses account access, an administrator issues a one-time password reset link after identity verification.
Recovery keys must be rotated every 90 days. The security lead schedules key rotation and records completion.
To replace a recovery key, the security lead creates a new key, validates a restore, and then revokes the old key.
For a building emergency, call Facilities at 555-0100 and notify the site coordinator.
Printer maintenance includes cleaning the rollers monthly and checking the paper feed.

cases.reference_answer: Keys are rotated every 90 days; a replacement is validated with a restore before the old key is revoked.
